Item Description Qty Unit Unit price (BDT) Amount (BDT)
B Metal zipper, 18 cm 16,500 piece 35.00 577,500.00
Subtotal 577,500.00
VAT 15% 86,625.00
Total 664,125.00
Supplier TIN: 107458073391 BIN: 000770741-0101
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
1. Payment. No advance payment required. Payment within 45 days of delivery.
2. Delivery. Delivery within 22 days of PO.
3. Delay. Late delivery penalty: 0.5% of order value per week.
4. Validity. This quotation is valid for 35 days from the date above.
5. Quality. Goods are supplied as per the buyer's approved sample. Defective goods will be replaced at the
supplier's cost.
6. Disputes. Any dispute will first be settled by discussion; failing that, through arbitration in Dhaka.
For Rupsha Zipper Factory
Authorised signatory (fictional sample document)
